title.narrative: Assessing the feasibility to produce premixes in Ghana

description.narrative: Royal Blue & Orange International Trading B.V. (RBO) is an approved vendor of Domino’s Pizza International, who is rapidly taking over the African continent with its franchises. Premix is one of the key ingredients for pizza dough all DPI franchises worldwide need to purchase from an approved vendor. Currently there is only one premix manufacturer, based in the United States of America, causing all sorts of import and shipping issues of premix to each individual country DPI is present. RBO aims to invest in a local manufacturing and packaging facility in Ghana in order to supply premix to the entire African continent, taking away many of these issues and contributing to local sourcing of ingredients and the supply chain required for this. Ghana is chosen because of the good investment climate and opportunities related to logistics and distribution. Technical Assistance (DGGF-TF) provided support to prepare for the future investment and to provide a bankable business case to attract investors and external finance. The project included support to search and select partners, to assess the investment climate and identify the best location, to assess and organise the raw material supply chain to enable traceability, to research the required equipment modifications to match electricity supply, to identify logistical partners, to assess the availability of local staff and skills required and to develop a financial plan for the future. The project provided all the required information and preparations for future investments and is expected to result in the set-up of a premix manufacturing facility with a capacity of 2.4 million kg per year with the potential to create 100 direct jobs.
